description: Search PUBLIC posts by keyword (social listening). Platforms: bluesky (sort latest|top, cursor pagination) and threads. Threads keyword search has a Meta-imposed budget of 500 searches per rolling 7 days per account, shared with the Schedulala dashboard - the response reports usage; prefer bluesky for exploratory searching. Each result includes its reply target so you can respond via reply_to_comment (bluesky: platformData.replyRefs; threads: the result id as postId).

accountId.description: Optional. Account to search as (from list_accounts).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (bluesky only).

q.description: Required. Keyword or phrase to search for.

name: search_feeds
title: Search Feeds
